method: Four jobs, one per method: none (SamplerV2), recipe (SamplerV2: readout calibration + native folding 1/3/5, analyzed with recipe.py), IBM EstimatorV2 resilience_level 1, IBM EstimatorV2 resilience_level 2.
Compilation: level 2, best of 20 transpiler seeds (fewest two-qubit gates, then depth).

none and recipe get the same estimated quantum seconds per circuit; IBM levels get the same shots per circuit as none (precision 1/sqrt(shots)) and add their own overhead. Measured quantum_seconds are read from each job.
RMSE vs exact noise-free values; spread = bootstrap std (Sampler: multinomial resampling of counts; Estimator: normal draws from the reported std).
